::: {#hero-heading}
My name is Seamus Murphy and I'm a forester specializing in stand mensuration and carbon verification. I completed my PhD at SOAS, University of London in 2015 and an MSc in Environmental Forestry at Bangor University in 2019. As a Registered Professional Forester (SIFTM #1125) and Forest Carbon Analyst at [TÜV SÜD](https://www.tuvsud.com/en-us/about-us/north-america), I audit carbon offset programs under VCS, ACR, ARB, PEFC, and ART standards.

Over the years, I have observed forest monitoring systems fail not from flawed science, but from inaccessible workflows and poor documentation. This drives my commitment to developing open-source tools and reproducible frameworks in R and Python that verification teams can deploy and maintain. From Monte Carlo uncertainty quantification to enhanced forest inventory protocols, I prioritize transparent methods, QA/QC documentation, and version-controlled workflows ([2026](https://seamusrobertmurphy.quarto.pub/redd-uncertainty-training/), [2025a](https://seamusrobertmurphy.quarto.pub/art-trees-submission/), [2025b](https://seamusrobertmurphy.quarto.pub/vm0048/), [2025c](https://rpubs.com/seamusmurphy/art-trees-monte-carlo-uncertainty), [2022c](https://seamusrobertmurphy.quarto.pub/cffdrs/)).

Workflows also cover applications in LiDAR, RADAR, and multispectral imagery for forest health monitoring ([2023a](https://rpubs.com/seamusmurphy/gov_sk_tree_height_variability), [2024a](https://rpubs.com/seamusmurphy/mapping-endorheic-wetland-dynamics)), as well as in-situ data scaling, GPS accuracy assessments and open-source survey deployment systems ([2019](https://eu.kobotoolbox.org/#/forms/ajw7YvwXFgCgVaaAiz9Xrm/data/map), [2021a](https://seamusmurphy.shinyapps.io/shiny-project-V8/), [2021b](https://drive.google.com/file/d/126oyAzNCa386aIZLus7oO3_kk9PRmnAd/view?usp=sharing), [2022a](https://viewscreen.githubusercontent.com/view/pdf?browser=safari&bypass_fastly=true&color_mode=dark&commit=9a09556452d67378b9d3657d4ba537993426889a&device=unknown_device&docs_host=https%3A%2F%2Fdocs.github.com&enc_&link_underline_enabled=true&logged_in=true&nwo=seamusrobertmurphy%2FGPS-training-material&path=GPS+SOP+-+Road+Survey+in+ESRI+FieldMaps.pdf&platform=mac&repository_id=691993657&repository_type=Repository&version=18#56d1471b-3313-4786-9de3-4b7cd916e501), [2022b](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JKMX_JB21j3FkHIiZ1dzqFHFGgdaIdgb/view?usp=sharing)).
